propositions: Validation logic is sometimes implemented in CLI commands while MCP/library/reconciler code paths skip it, creating inconsistent enforcement across interfaces.

A new ADVISORY plan-review criterion (project.engine-layer-enforcement) should trigger deterministically when plan file_impact touches src/rebar/_commands/ or interface modules alongside validation/guard/check work.
The criterion should be registered in the criteria routing overlay and guide, generating advisory findings that flag CLI-only validation placement and suggest engine-layer alternatives.
rebar explain <id> must successfully render the registered criterion definition.
Advisory posture allows legitimate interface-local validation while teaching reviewers the engine-vs-interface enforcement seam.
